fine_trace.note: Input bidi_types and bracket_types are encoded into a linked run list with isolate links (prev_isolate, next_isolate) connecting runs at the same isolate level.

fine_trace.code: for_run_list (list, list) if (RL_TYPE (list->prev) == RL_TYPE (list) && RL_LEVEL (list->prev) == RL_LEVEL (list) && RL_BRACKET_TYPE(list) == FRIBIDI_NO_BRACKET && RL_BRACKET_TYPE(list->prev) == FRIBIDI_NO_BRACKET) list = merge_with_prev (list);
fine_trace.note: compact_list iterates through the run list and merges adjacent runs with same type and level. The merge operation frees nodes but does not correctly maintain all isolate link pointers, leaving dangling pointers.

After freeing second (line 96), first->next_isolate is set to second->next_isolate unconditionally, overwriting first's existing isolate link. This causes other nodes that still reference second through isolate links to become dangling pointers, leading to heap-use-after-free when those pointers are later dereferenced during subsequent merge_with_prev calls.
